messages:
Ravi: Daily async check-in — quick pipeline/enterprise security notes
- Yesterday: demo with MacroHealth, legal asked for HSM/KMS architecture + proof of no key export
- Blocker: need clarity on HSM behavior for our Private/on-prem deploy (customer-held keys vs connector)
- Today: gather doc from eng and send updated diagram to MacroHealth PO @Jordan by EOD

Jordan: Got it — I can own the diagram upload and the PO follow-up. @Priya any short guidance we can give them now?

Priya: Short answer: Private deployments support KMS integrations; on-prem package supports HSM via our connector. Important nuance: currently customers don't upload raw key material into our hosted KMS — for true customer-held keys we recommend dedicated on-prem HSM. Need to check exact contractual wording for "customer-kept keys."

Ava: I skimmed MacroHealth SOW — they require FIPS 140-2 certified HSM and explicit "no key material exported" clause. @SecurityBot can you confirm what artefacts we need to share to satisfy them?

SecurityBot: Security FYI — we require an architecture diagram, key lifecycle description, and a controls checklist. Please create SEC ticket SEC-295 and attach: (1) deployment PKI flow, (2) where keys are generated/stored, (3) access controls/audit logs. If keys are customer-held on-prem, we need a short runbook for key rotation and incident handling. :mag_right:

Ravi: Thanks. I will draft the diagram and open SEC-295. Quick technical ask: who can write a 1-paragraph latency/SLA impact note if we recommend Dedicated + on-prem HSM? MacroHealth wants to understand perf tradeoffs.

Jordan: I can draft perf note. Quick numbers to include: synchronous HSM ops add ~3-8ms per signing op; with caching/session tokens we can amortize that cost. Also call out lead time & pricing delta for Dedicated on-prem. I'll drop a short blurb into the Confluence doc.

Priya: Also note pricing implications — Dedicated + on-prem HSM will change both unit pricing and provisioning lead time. I'll update the quote and attach to the doc.

Ava: :thumbsup: Perfect. Ravi — ping me once the diagram is posted and I'll check legal phrasing. Also flag eng if a connector change / CR is needed.

Ravi: Will do. Thanks all — I'll post the initial diagram by 5pm and tag everyone.
